faculty.name: Daphna Buchsbaum
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development and social learning in children and dogs using computational models and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和狗的认知发展和社会学习，使用计算模型和行为实验的方法。

faculty.name: Ruth Colwill
faculty.summary: Studies animal learning and behavior, early adverse experiences, and canine communication systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物学习与行为、早期不良经历以及犬类交流系统。

faculty.name: Fulvio Domini
faculty.summary: Studies how the human visual system processes 3D visual information for successful interactions with the environment, using computational methods and behavioral studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类视觉系统如何处理3D视觉信息以成功与环境互动，采用计算方法和行为研究。

faculty.name: Serra Favila
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of episodic memory using functional neuroimaging, intracranial recordings, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情景记忆的神经基础，使用功能性神经成像、颅内记录和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Roman Feiman
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop higher-level cognitive skills, focusing on language acquisition and formal semantics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童高级认知技能的发展，特别是语言习得和形式语义学。

faculty.name: Oriel FeldmanHall
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals navigate social interactions and make decisions in complex social networks, using neuroimaging and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体如何在复杂的社会网络中进行社会互动和决策，使用神经成像和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Michael Frank
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of reinforcement learning, decision making, and cognitive control using computational modeling and experimental techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究强化学习、决策和认知控制的神经机制，使用计算建模和实验技术。

faculty.name: William Heindel
faculty.summary: Studies human memory, attention, and perception in neurologically intact individuals and brain-damaged patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正常个体和脑损伤患者的记忆、注意力和知觉认知神经科学。

faculty.name: Joachim Krueger
faculty.summary: Studies social judgment and decision-making, including self-perception and intergroup relations, with intersections in behavioral economics and organizational behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会判断与决策，包括自我知觉和群体关系，涉及行为经济学和组织行为学。

faculty.name: David Levari
faculty.summary: Studies judgment and decision-making, social and cognitive psychology, using behavioral experiments and computational models to understand why people often take on tasks inappropriately and how.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究判断与决策、社会与认知心理学，通过行为实验和计算模型来理解人们为何常常不恰当地承担任务以及绩效评估为何会变得不那么准确。

faculty.name: Bertram F. Malle
faculty.summary: Studies social cognition, moral psychology, and human-robot interaction, focusing on intentionality, blame, and moral competence in robots.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知、道德心理学和人机交互，重点关注意图性、责备和机器人中的道德能力。

faculty.name: Julia Marshall
faculty.summary: Studies the development of moral and social cognition in children and adults, using experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人道德和社会认知的发展，采用实验方法。

faculty.name: Andrea Megela Simmons
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of sound perception and communication in frogs, echolocating bats, dolphins, and humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究声音感知和交流的认知和神经机制，涉及青蛙、回声定位蝙蝠、海豚和人类。

faculty.name: Jason Okonofua
faculty.summary: Studies how racial stereotypes affect teacher-student relationships and develops interventions to mitigate racial disparities in discipline.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究种族刻板印象如何影响师生关系，并开发干预措施以减轻纪律处分中的种族差异。

faculty.name: Frederike Petzschner
faculty.summary: Studies higher-level cognition and neural/computational models of mind, brain, and behavior, focusing on perception and action.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知和神经/计算模型的心智、大脑和行为，侧重于知觉和行动。

faculty.name: Thomas Serre
faculty.summary: Studies neural computations supporting visual perception, combining biological and artificial vision.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究支持视觉感知的神经计算，结合生物视觉和人工视觉。

faculty.name: Steven Sloman
faculty.summary: Studies how people think and make decisions, focusing on collective cognition and the interaction of thought systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们的思维和决策过程，特别是集体认知以及思维系统的交互作用。

faculty.name: Dave Sobel
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn from parent-child interaction and their causal reasoning in early education, linking cognitive and social development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童从亲子互动中学习以及早期教育中的因果推理，将认知发展和社会道德发展相结合。

faculty.name: Joo-Hyun Song
faculty.summary: Studies how multiple systems involved in visual attention, target selection, and motor control work together to interact with complex environments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉注意、目标选择和运动控制等多个系统如何协同工作以应对复杂环境。

faculty.name: William Warren
faculty.summary: Studies how visual information controls human locomotion, navigation, and collective motion using virtual reality techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉信息如何控制人类的运动、导航和集体行为，使用虚拟现实技术。

faculty.name: Takeo Watanabe
faculty.summary: Studies how attention and reinforcement signals influence perceptual learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力和强化信号在知觉学习中的作用。

faculty.name: Lio Wong
faculty.summary: Studies how human minds efficiently learn and use language, including subjective aspects like storytelling and emotions, using experiments and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何高效地学习和使用语言，包括叙述故事和情感等主观方面，使用实验和计算模型的方法。

faculty.name: Yuka Sasaki
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Christopher Hill
faculty.summary: Studies higher-level cognition and perception and action.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知和知觉与动作。

faculty.name: Matt Nassar
faculty.summary: Studies neural and computational models of higher-level cognition, perception and action using behavioral neuroscience and cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知、知觉和行动的神经和计算模型，采用行为神经科学和认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Hwamee Oh
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and psychological mechanisms, focusing on the interplay between cognition and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程和心理机制，重点关注认知与行为之间的相互作用。

faculty.name: Ellie Pavlick
faculty.summary: Studies neural and computational models of mind, brain, and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心智、大脑和行为的神经和计算模型。

faculty.name: Apoorva Bhandari
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算模型和行为实验研究认知过程。

faculty.name: Drew Linsley
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Carlos Aizenman
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory experience shapes the connectivity and functional properties of developing neural circuits in the visual system of Xenopus laevis tadpoles, using electrophysiology, imaging, and.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉经验如何塑造发育中视觉系统神经回路的连接性和功能特性，使用电生理学、成像和建模方法。

faculty.name: Gilad Barnea
faculty.summary: Develops trans-synaptic labeling systems to trace and functionally study neural circuits in mice, focusing on olfactory and gustatory systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发跨突触标记系统以追踪和功能研究小鼠的嗅觉和味觉神经回路。

faculty.name: David Berson
faculty.summary: Studies the structure and function of retinal neurons and their signals to the brain, focusing on ganglion cells and their roles in visual behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经元的结构和功能及其对大脑的信号传递，重点关注视网膜节细胞及其在视觉行为中的作用。

faculty.name: Anda Chirila
faculty.summary: Studies the functional organization and plasticity of neural circuits mediating touch and pain, using mouse molecular-genetic tools and in vivo electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉和疼痛的神经环路的功能组织和可塑性，使用小鼠分子遗传工具和在体电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Theresa Desrochers
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive sequence control from single neurons to brain networks in both humans and animals, using fMRI, TMS, and high-density recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知序列控制从单个神经元到脑网络的机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和高密度记录，涵盖人类和动物模型。

faculty.name: Alexander Fleischmann
faculty.summary: Studies how neural circuits in the mouse olfactory cortex process sensory stimuli to generate perception and behavior, using molecular genetic, imaging, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠嗅皮层神经回路如何处理感官刺激以产生感知和行为，使用分子遗传学、成像和计算方法。

faculty.name: Diane Hoffman-Kim
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular neurobiology and neural circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究细胞和分子神经生物学及神经回路。

faculty.name: Karla Kaun
faculty.summary: Studies genetic, molecular, and neural mechanisms of reward and addiction using fruit flies, combining genetics, behavior, and in vivo imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究奖励和成瘾的遗传、分子和神经机制，使用果蝇结合遗传学、行为和体内成像方法。

faculty.name: Leenoy Meshulam
faculty.summary: Studies how large networks of cells generate collective function in nervous systems and brains, using statistical-physics approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用统计物理学方法研究神经网络如何生成集体功能。

faculty.name: Michael Paradiso
faculty.summary: Studies how visual perception and information processing in V1 are affected by saccades and natural vision, using neurophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视皮层V1在眨眼和自然视觉影响下的知觉和信息处理，使用神经生理学方法。

faculty.name: Jerome Sanes
faculty.summary: Studies brain mechanisms of voluntary movement and motor learning using MRI and surface brain electrical recording.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自愿运动和运动学习的大脑机制，使用MRI和头皮脑电图记录技术。

faculty.name: David Sheinberg
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes dynamic visual information and how perceptual learning changes neural responses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理动态视觉信息以及知觉学习如何改变神经反应。

faculty.name: James A. Simmons
faculty.summary: Studies how bats perceive their environment using ultrasonic echolocation, focusing on neural processing in the bat's brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蝙蝠如何使用超声波回声定位感知环境，重点在于蝙蝠大脑中的神经处理机制。
